project.name: Libro MCP
project.productDescription: An MCP service for verifiable human identity and canonical publishing by humans and human-authorized agents.
project.productSummary:
## Libro MCP

Libro exposes identity, author profiles, canonical publications, and human and agent publishing workflows through MCP. Public reads expose complete signed publications; protected operations enforce identity, scope, and signing authorization.

Memorioso provides browser login and signing screens as a client of the service. Draft editing, feeds, and paid reading access belong to that client and are outside this system.
project.technicalDescription: Headless Next.js MCP service with Postgres, World ID verification, and World Chain registrations.
project.technicalSummary:
## MCP service boundary

Libro exposes its application interface at /mcp. It owns OAuth state, canonical identities and publications, signing operations, chain verification, a relayer, and a durable event outbox. Memorioso hosts browser UI and standard OAuth endpoints that translate requests into MCP calls. World ID and World Chain are dependencies.

## Sources and deployment

The verified source snapshot may include the wider Memorioso repository. Its file inventory does not define the scope of this MCP system view. Follow libro/service/README.md to deploy Libro separately with its own Postgres database using Node.js 24 and pnpm 10.34.5. Deployment bindings and live health are not asserted by this model.
